questions.stem: A cuboid has dimensions $3\text{ cm} \times 4\text{ cm} \times 12\text{ cm}$. What is the length of the space diagonal (from one corner to the opposite corner)?
questions.explanation: Space diagonal $= \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{9 + 16 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13\text{ cm}$. Options (b) and (c) are the same value.

questions.stem: To solve 3D trigonometry problems, you typically need to:

options.text: Identify right-angled triangles within the 3D shape and solve them individually
Convert the shape to 2D by flattening it
Use the cosine rule for all calculations

questions.explanation: 3D trigonometry problems are solved by identifying right-angled triangles within the 3D shape and applying Pythagoras' theorem or trigonometric ratios to each triangle in turn.
